MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 40
   C. 30
   D. 75

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

4. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 10
   C. 9
   D. 40.5

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 32
   C. 55
   D. 16

7. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 25

9. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

10. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

11. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

12. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
